question.text: Auction pay-in and pay-out happens on:

answer.text: T+2 (Auction + 1 day), with pay-in generally by 8:00 AM

explanation.text: The Logic: The auction session is conducted on T+1, and auction pay-in and pay-out happen on Auction + 1 day, i.e. T+2, with pay-in generally completed by 8:00 AM. The Trap: The auction itself is on T+1, but its pay-in/pay-out is one day later on T+2; same-day or T+3 timelines do not match the workbook schedule. Note: Schedule only: auction on T+1, auction pay-in/pay-out on Auction + 1 day (T+2), with pay-in generally by 8:00 AM.
